pages.title: Quantum String
pages.text: A one-dimensional vibrating string, the fundamental object of string theory. Its mode of vibration decides what it is: one note an electron, another a photon, another a graviton. In the hand it is a thread of light that hums, changing its tune slightly with my pulse.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The String Resonance Loom stretched a Cosmic String Segment down to the Planck scale, tuned it with a Tachyon Crystal and held it in a Superposition Crystal. When it began to vibrate in discrete modes, I knew it was a string.
